questions.question: What does Zechariah 14 say about the LORD in the day of the LORD?
options: He will carry all of the people away into a long and bitter exile
He will go out and fight, and his feet shall stand on the Mount of Olives
He will hide away his face and leave the whole city to fall to ruin
He will at last make a lasting peace with all of the surrounding nations
questions.answer: He will go out and fight, and his feet shall stand on the Mount of Olives

questions.question: What climactic declaration ends Zechariah 14?
options: The long and bitter famine will at last end, and the land will yield its fruit
The temple will be rebuilt in far greater glory than it had ever once known before
The LORD will be king over all the earth; the LORD will be one and his name one
Mighty Babylon will at last fall, never again to rise up forever and ever
questions.answer: The LORD will be king over all the earth; the LORD will be one and his name one
